walletSetup.title: Create Your Wallet
walletSetup.description: Welcome to Veiled! Start by creating a new wallet or importing an existing one. Your wallet secures your identity on the marketplace.

nodeSync.title: Sync With the Blockchain
nodeSync.description: Your node will download and sync with the Cardano blockchain. This is a one-time setup that takes 10-20 minutes. You can continue in the background.

marketplace.title: Browse the Marketplace
marketplace.description: The Marketplace tab shows all available encrypted data listings. Browse categories, check prices, and find data you want to purchase.

firstBid.title: Place Your First Bid
firstBid.description: Found something interesting? Click on a listing to see details, then place a bid with your desired price. The seller can accept your bid to complete the exchange.
